items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: He was going to the same dentist here in Beverly Hills that I used to go to.

ctx.x: And he was 16 years old when he met the band, working in his father's cleaning store. And when the band left town, he couldn't stand it, so he left with them -- ran away.
And you know the funny part about it? He was going to the same dentist here in Beverly Hills that I used to go to.
Juan went to the dentist one day and who comes in but Bob Udakoff.
